name: Mado Suzumu
source:
Director of Mado Psychics. Argumentative, money-hungry, and Harushige's childhood best friend. Avoids responsibility at all costs. While he tends to look down on others, he is surprisingly shy.

[From Love 365's in-app character introduction.]
